message.reasoning_content: Phase action round 2. I have 17M cash. Subsidy active: shuttle gives 3+1=4 goods, produce gives 2+1=3. Donkey costs 1. Buy goods? No buy in action phase — buy is market. Best: shuttle gives 4 goods, risk 25% confiscation — still best EV. Or produce 3 free. Shuttle EV 4*0.75=3 vs produce 3. Shuttle slightly better, and no cash tribute issue (no favorable border role mentioned). Go shuttle.
